origin: A name given by Edward Tufte, a researcher of statistical graphics, who defined it as a word-sized graphic.
whenToUse: You add a trend to each row of a table.
Next to the number on a KPI card.
You scan the trend of many items at a glance.
whenNotToUse: Exact values must be read (use a line chart).
Each row has a different scale, which could mislead.
There are three points or fewer.

alternatives.name: KPI Card
alternatives.reason: The current value and change matter more than the trend.

accessibility: The SVG has role="img" with a description that includes the first and last values.
The exact latest value sits as text in the next cell.
Make clear through the layout that each row has its own scale, so only the shapes should be compared.
